events.name: Kennesaw State Owls at Missouri State Bears

headlines.description: — Yousef Obeid kicked a 20-yard field goal as time expired, Henry Belin IV had a career-high 300 yards passing and threw two touchdown passes to Isaiah Myers, and Missouri State defeated Kennesaw State 24-21 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Obeid kicks 20-yard FG as time expires, Missouri State beats Kennesaw State 24-21
